text: Git commit hook runner printed a missing lefthook configuration warning in the FRIGID worktree even though the commit succeeded; suppress the runner when no config exists.
Shared NFS reached 100% and failed the adaptation launcher before training; the launcher needed a local run/cache fallback.
git push to origin failed through the local proxy (connection closed on 127.0.0.1:3129); local commits remain available
The optional periodic-evaluation test path was absent, so the combined pytest command needed a fallback to the available molecular suite.
ClearML offline import reached the private API but hung without output or timeout; importer needs bounded network timeouts and actionable progress/errors.
